title: iGet Pranky
description: After some fans submit a video of a prank to the web-show, Carly, Sam and Freddie discuss pranks they've pulled in the past, and Carly begins to feel self-conscious about never having pulled any of her own. When she asks Spencer to help her pull one on Sam and Freddie, it sends him on a pranking rampage the likes of which Seattle hasn't experienced since he was in Junior High School.
